value.name: Getting Started in Medical Student Research: Library Resources & Research Basics
value.description:
These two sessions, led by Sarah Hughes, Health Sciences Librarian with Drexel University Libraries, will introduce medical students to library resources and foundational research skills. Topics will include getting started with research, developing a research question, understanding different types of projects such as literature reviews, scoping reviews, and systematic reviews, choosing appropriate databases, building a search strategy, and using concepts such as MeSH terms, PICO, and PRISMA.

The sessions will also include time for questions and discussion. This event is especially intended for students interested in beginning or strengthening research projects over the summer, but all DUCOM students are welcome to attend.

value.name: ISSS Lunch & Dialogue: Student Situational Preparedness w/ Drexel's Department of Public Safety
value.description:
Students living in a new city and attending college are susceptible to encountering dangerous situations. Being aware of your surroundings and recognizing situations that are potentially dangerous are key to keeping yourself safe. There are measures students can take to prevent themselves from being victims of a crime. Drexel's Department of Public Safety will provide tips to encourage students to think and act accordingly—not to be scared, but to be prepared.

Light lunch will be provided for students who RSVPed on DragonLink.

We are proud to celebrate the incredible journeys of our graduating seniors — and the cultures, stories, and communities that have shaped them. This year, we invite you to join the entire Drexel community as we celebrate your unique experiences and your time as a Dragon!  

This exciting event will feature music, food, complimentary headshots, and meaningful moments to honor our Drexel seniors. Graduates can connect with family, friends, and enjoy festivities as we celebrate Drexel's Class of 2026.

We meet for Community Groups on Wednesdays/Thursdays on Campus. The specific building & room varies, so text “Crosswalk” to 94000 to connect with us, so we can help you get plugged in! We also meet for Sunday Worship at Metro Church (East Falls), 9:30AM/11:30AM. Rides are provided to both services! Text “Crosswalk” to 94000 for more information on rides.

If you have any questions, you can email andrew@metrophilly.org. Follow our Instagram @CrosswalkFellowship to stay in the loop!

value.name: So You're Thinking About a PhD?
value.description:
Hosted by UREP and the Steinbright Career Development Center, this session will help applicants demystify the PhD application process. value.name: SAFE Program
value.description:
Whether you're looking to feel more confident on campus or simply want to be more prepared, SAFE (Self-Awareness for Everyone) is here for you. Drexel Public Safety's free self-protection program gives students, faculty, and staff the practical skills, mindset, and resources to stay safe and protect themselves in any situation.

In this 3-hour hands-on class, you'll learn basic striking techniques, how to defend against grabs and chokes, ground defense, and how to report safety concerns through DPS — all in a welcoming, no-experience-needed environment.
